name: Deltoid
description: The deltoid forms the rounded contour of the shoulder with three heads that collaborate to position the arm in space. Artists study its sweeping volume to capture the shoulder's expressive gestures.
actions: Abducts the glenohumeral joint, especially from 15 to 90 degrees.
Assists with flexion and medial rotation of the arm through the anterior fibers.
Assists with extension and lateral rotation of the arm through the posterior fibers.
